text:
emily: FYI — the new ATS dedupe rule that merged on prod at 08:12 this AM merged ~40 candidates from yesterday's inbound CSV. Some scorecards and panel assignments disappeared. Noticed by recruiting ops.

jon: :eyes: can you paste an example candidate ID? is this email-based dedupe or phone?

emily: Example: candidate 98765 and 98766 were merged into 98765 (email matched but different profiles). recruiter ID mapping lost. Query we ran: 
```
SELECT id, email, scorecards_count FROM candidates WHERE email = 'jane@example.com';
```

recruiter-bot: deploy: dedupe-service v1.4.2 deployed to prod by @deploy-bot at 2026-03-23 08:12 UTC

maria: :facepalm: that's the rule we changed to be more aggressive. We added fuzzy email normalization. Rolling back is my suggestion.

sam: I'll open an incident ticket + rollback PR. Ticket: https://example.com/ticket/RI-3421

leah: Any impact on open reqs? we had 5 active interviews with those candidates.

emily: Yes 3 panels had scorecards disappear — Nino, Priya, and Ops PM loop. Recruiters were notified.

jon: @eng-oncall can you pause any further dedupe runs and hold cron until rollback applied?

dev-deploy-bot: cron: dedupe job paused by @eng-oncall at 2026-03-23 09:01 UTC

sam: PR created to revert commit (link) — rolling back now. Will post when done.

maria: Once rolled back, we need a data-reconciliation plan. I can CSV export merged groups and restore mappings.

emily: Thanks. Can recruiting ops stop outreach to affected candidates until we confirm? :thumbsup: 

leah: Will pause outreach and ping affected hiring managers.

sam: Rollback complete at 09:18 UTC. Reconciliation ticket created RI-3422.

emily: Great — please confirm when scorecards are restored. Thanks everyone.

maria: Will follow up with timeline (ETA 4 hrs) — will update RI-3422.

recruiter-bot: reminder: please run local test on staging dedupe rule before next release.

jon: note for postmortem: add interviewer training to spot merged candidate side-effects in scorecards.

emily: Agreed — add to next week's interviewer training agenda.
